lead: Fly into Brno if you can — otherwise Vienna.

gateways.name: Brno (BRQ)
gateways.thenToBrno: You're there (8 km / ~15 min to centre)

gateways.name: Vienna (VIE)
gateways.flyFromUK: Austrian & BA from Heathrow, Ryanair from Stansted, Wizz/easyJet from Luton/Gatwick; regional UK via Jet2 (Manchester, Edinburgh, Bristol, Glasgow, Newcastle, Leeds). ~daily, ~2h15, from ~£55
gateways.thenToBrno: RegioJet bus from the airport, hourly, every day, ~2h10, ~€12
gateways.bestFor: Best all-rounder. Regional UK family + anyone needing Sun/Mon returns

gateways.name: Bratislava (BTS)
gateways.flyFromUK: Ryanair / Buzz / Wizz direct from Stansted, ~2h15, most days, £16–37
gateways.thenToBrno: ~9 km to Bratislava centre, then FlixBus/RegioJet ~1.5–2h
gateways.bestFor: Cheap backup if Brno/Vienna fares spike

gateways.name: Prague (PRG)
gateways.bestFor: Only for a bargain UK→Prague fare

mixAndMatch.title: Mixing and matching
mixAndMatch.intro: You don't have to fly in and out the same way.
points: Fly into Brno, fly home from Vienna — cheap direct flight in, then the hourly RegioJet bus to Vienna airport for any day's return.
Stay till Tuesday — the Brno direct flight runs Tue–Sat, so if you're with us at the reservoir through the weekend, a Tuesday flight home means no transfer at all.
mixAndMatch.rule: When in doubt: Brno in, Vienna out.

groundBooking.note: One booking link covers all ground legs — Vienna, Bratislava and the Prague train.
